hints.title: Individual Element Clamping
hints.text: Clamp each array element using min(x, cap) before selection.

hints.title: Greedy Top K Selection
hints.text: Sorting the clamped values in descending order reveals the k largest contributions.

hints.title: Prefix Summation
hints.text: Sum the first k elements of the sorted clamped array.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Sorting clamped elements and summing the k largest values.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Examining all combinations of size k takes exponential time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Allocates array of size N for clamped values.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Clamp values first and greedily select the largest elements.
